SHIPPED: Complete rewrite of WhisnapKeyboard/RecordingOverlayView.swift
KEY PATTERNS:
- stateGeneration: Int counter incremented on each state transition; animation completion closures capture generation and guard: `guard self.stateGeneration == generation else { return }`
- barHeightConstraints cached at setup (not filtered per frame) for 30fps waveform performance
- globeButton stored as weak ref in KeyboardView; showGlobe setter toggles isHidden only (no rebuildLayout)
- transcript pill width constraint activated AFTER pill added to superview (avoid cross-hierarchy crash)
HAPTICS:
- recording start: UIImpactFeedbackGenerator(.medium)
- stop/cancel: UIImpactFeedbackGenerator(.light)
- done: UINotificationFeedbackGenerator(.success)
- error: UINotificationFeedbackGenerator(.error)
STATE HOLD: done state shows for 1.2s before revertToKeyboard
